rationale: Every feasible run kept 4-14 ns of positive setup slack, so setup repair never kicked in. T_eff therefore comes from synthesis and placement. Tighter targets look better (frac about 0.5: 6.5-8.2 ns; frac 0.93-0.98: 10-11 ns), so pin the tightest target. The three best runs (6.47-6.87) all used timing-driven placement, no routability spreading and post-GRT design repair, and DELAY 3 gave the best result (6.47). Both crashes had util 38-40 while the best runs used 21-30, so pin util at 22. Post-GRT timing repair does nothing at these targets but should help the confirmation re-runs near 6.5 ns. Leave buffering, sizing, RC model, density, margins and repair percentages to the optimizer.
